id: AT-AP-31 (third review: gate words only in the clauses that grant)
note: 0.1.16 third review (probes N1-N9): _words_name_gates reads the quote's granting clauses only: split at . ; ! ? and at but / except / unless / however, kept when the clause holds a non-negated standing phrase and its sentence is no question, cut at the first not/don't/never/no outside its standing phrases. A protected branch counts only right after push/merge in such a clause, with at most four link words between; only the branches the push goes to (the action, a branch target) are needed. A negation within three words before the standing phrase fails closed (no worries, feel free to push to main re-asks).
